storySynopsis.title: The founding record
storySynopsis.text: The founder recorded the AXIOM birth event, the AXI.Core command record, and the KEYSTONE sacred record of 2026-08-28. The constitutional and rights sources and a cryptographic origin anchor were preserved. The intent was clear from the start: origin first, then ownership, then value. Most of it existed as founding sources, not as an operating system.

storySynopsis.title: Consolidation and the first governance layer
storySynopsis.text: In three days the work moved into one monorepo, gained the Genesis ownership checkpoint, the Creator Origin Constitution, the constitutional framework, ordered objectives, and a consolidated business plan. Ownership was declared internally; external registration was not yet started.

storySynopsis.title: Production strain and the first recorded losses
storySynopsis.text: Chat outages, crashes, and stale deployments consumed effort. The founder reported roughly 500GB of data loss and an IP-ownership switch; these were recorded as unverified claims because the repository cannot prove them. Duplicate automation PRs were closed and CI-gated merges were introduced.

storySynopsis.title: Founder language and the symbolic corpus
storySynopsis.text: Origin definition, the universal unit, coordinate, resequencer, and URNUR vocabulary were captured as attributed founder statements, and a profitability-ordered action queue appeared. Meaning was being preserved, but as statements, not as registered, operational records.

storySynopsis.title: Ownership paperwork, verification, and the first audit
storySynopsis.text: The ownership checklist was written, Axes Contracting Inc and CSLB license #995577 were confirmed from the official source, the service-delivery protocol was added, and the first agent performance audit named failures plainly. A missed UI-image instruction led to the reference-asset intake protocol and PR-template enforcement.

storySynopsis.title: Accountability merged with self-origin declarations
storySynopsis.text: PR #173 merged the directive-vs-delivery ledger together with the self-origin and coordinate-center declarations and the investigation register. Chat uploads and the Command Center design followed. This is the strongest point where origin, ownership, and accountability met in one merged change.

storySynopsis.title: The unmerged tranche
storySynopsis.text: Origin Science, the OORR-P registry, production-rights attribution, the task-record system, terminology, and founder-review tooling were all built in PRs that remain open. The registration layer the founder asked for exists, but not on the canonical branch, which is why the same meaning keeps being re-established.
